verdict.rationale: Expensify offers real-time capture (SmartScan reads receipts instantly, no batch delays) and AI-driven analytics for 'monthly spend' and 'quarterly flux analysis,' plus GL coding for categorization — suggesting near-real-time spend visibility by category/merchant. However, hands-on community reports say Expensify's categorization is wrong ~70% of the time and relies on outsourced manual data entry, directly undermining the 'by category' accuracy claim; other users cite slow processing (20 min per receipt) contradicting 'real time.' Missing for 10: a dedicated team/department spend dashboard, documented real-time merchant/category breakdowns, and independent verification of AI analytics accuracy.
